title: Design and evaluate sheet
subject: Art & Design
unit: Summer 2: Observational drawing, pressed flowers and a scented sachet (The Scented Garden)
source: Written for art/y2 lesson 12 (Design and evaluate sheet (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 12: DT: design and make a fragrant sachet. Listen, look, then do the tasks with a grown-up.

panels.title: What is it for?
points: A sachet for a drawer or wardrobe

bullets: Whole cloves or a cinnamon stick

parts.text: Cut a 20 cm square of cloth
Tie tightly with ribbon or wool

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: A sachet that does not leak

keywords.def: a small cloth bag with something inside
say what went well and what to change

questions.q: Who is your sachet for, and where will it go?
questions.a: For example: for my mother's drawer

questions.q: Why must the filling be dried?
How will you close your sachet?
questions.a: Tie with ribbon or sew with running stitch

questions.q: Core: Draw and label your design (cloth, filling, how it closes), then make the sachet with an adult.
questions.a: A labelled design and a finished sachet that does not leak

questions.q: Extend: Shake your sachet gently: does it leak? Fix it if it does.
Stretch: Evaluate: what would you change next time?
questions.a: For example: use thicker cloth so the petals do not poke out

options: Hold its filling and smell nice
questions.a: A) Hold its filling and smell nice. Its job is to hold the dried filling and give off a nice smell.

questions.q: Big question: which smell did you choose, and why?
questions.a: For example: lavender because it smells calm
